historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to rehabilitate Helen Wills Playground, at Broadway and Larkin Streets, and build its field house to John J. Reynolds, Inc. at $79,500.

Unable to attend the dedication of the rehabilitated Helen Wills Playground, the tennis champion Helen Wills Roark sent the Recreation and Park Commission $500 for recreation and the playground, which it accepted.
The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $12,150 agreement with Philip P. Choy, architect, for improvements to Helen Wills Playground, for which he had drawn a master plan earlier in the year.
